findings.reason: Perf regression from the rev-0002 fix: 'release-diff:all' and 'release-diff:current' are batched under different ids, so a lifecycle + content event in one 500 ms window (release creation: release:created + file:changed releases/<slug>.json, + git:status-changed with git on) flush as two invalidateQueries; the second refetches with cancelRefetch → counter and full raw Compare diff requested twice. Make 'all' subsume 'current' in the window (drop a pending 'current' when 'all' is queued, or skip 'current' while 'all' is pending). Test: content + lifecycle event in one window → one counter fetch, one Compare fetch.

Invalidation wider than what changed: every file:changed counts as content regardless of rootId, including system roots (briefs, patches, plans, releases) that useFileWatcher already detects via systemRootKindOf. The release diff covers only 'pages'-kind roots plus entities (which have entity:changed). Skip file:changed from a system root without a facade (in releaseDiffInvalidationFor or gated in useFileWatcher). Test: file:changed with rootId 'briefs' leaves the counter un-invalidated.

Unused code (blocking per user rule): RELEASE_DIFF_INVALIDATING_EVENTS is read only by useUnreleasedCount.test.ts; isCurrentReleaseDiff (line 48) and RELEASE_DIFF_KEY (line 23) are exported with no reader outside the file. Un-export / remove them; build the test's list from the two exported arrays.
